title: Honeybee communication
text: Worker honeybees perform a waggle dance to communicate a food source's direction and distance to hive mates. The dance's angle relative to the Sun indicates direction, while its duration signals distance.

title: Ant foraging
text: Ants deposit pheromone trails to guide nestmates toward food. Stronger trails reinforce routes visited by many foragers.

title: Bat echolocation
text: Bats echolocate by emitting ultrasonic calls and interpreting returning echoes. They use the timing and direction of echoes to navigate and locate prey.
